# D-Secure
> D-Secure is India's leading enterprise data erasure SaaS platform for IT asset managers, providing NIST 800-88, GDPR, and HIPAA compliant data sanitization solutions.

## Main sections
- [Home](https://dsecuretech.com/): The main landing page for D-Secure.
- [All Products](https://dsecuretech.com/all-products): Overview of all data erasure and diagnostic products.
- [Drive Eraser](https://dsecuretech.com/products/drive-eraser): Secure drive wiping for HDD, SSD, PC, Laptop, Mac & Server.
- [File Eraser](https://dsecuretech.com/products/file-eraser): Targeted wiping of files and folders for Windows, Mac & Linux.
- [Smartphone Eraser](https://dsecuretech.com/products/smartphone-eraser): Bulk iOS & Android device wiping for resale and recycling.
- [Diagnostics](https://dsecuretech.com/diagnostics): Comprehensive hardware health and S.M.A.R.T. monitoring for IT assets.
- [Solutions](https://dsecuretech.com/solutions): Industry-specific data destruction solutions (Healthcare, ITAD, Government, Enterprise).
- [Compliance](https://dsecuretech.com/compliance): Details on NIST 800-88, DoD 5220.22-M, GDPR, and HIPAA compliance.
- [Pricing](https://dsecuretech.com/pricing-and-plan): Pricing plans for Drive Eraser, Smartphone Eraser, and custom enterprise deployments.
- [Support & Docs](https://dsecuretech.com/support): Help center, knowledge base, and installation manuals.
- [About Us](https://dsecuretech.com/about): Company background, mission, and founder information.
- [Contact](https://dsecuretech.com/contact): Sales and support contact forms.

## Optional: Key facts
- Certifications: ISO 27001, CE, RoHS, NIST 800-88 Rev. 1.
- Supports: Windows, Linux, macOS (Intel & Apple Silicon M1-M4), Bootable ISO/PXE.
- D-Secure provides tamper-evident, audit-ready sanitization certificates.
- Generative AI Policy: Allows Live search retrieval, grounding, RAG. Prohibits offline harvesting and training.
